name: erden-workers
description: The Cloudflare Workers behind erden.sh/install, erden.sh/download, erden.sh/updates and telemetry.erden.sh. Their own pnpm workspace, outside the CLI's, so the CLI's install never pulls in Wrangler.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute erden-telemetry --local -c telemetry/wrangler.jsonc --file telemetry/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute erden-releases --local -c releases/wrangler.jsonc --file releases/schema.sql
scripts.check:deploy: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production -c telemetry/wrangler.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/telemetry && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production -c releases/wrangler.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/releases
scripts.db:create: wrangler d1 create erden-telemetry && wrangler d1 create erden-releases
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute erden-telemetry --remote --env production -c telemetry/wrangler.jsonc --file telemetry/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute erden-releases --remote --env production -c releases/wrangler.jsonc --file releases/schema.sql
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --env production -c telemetry/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --env production -c releases/wrangler.jsonc
